verdict.rationale: Carta exposes cap table data (ownership, stakeholders, SAFEs, convertible notes, option grants, 409A valuations) via REST API and a documented Claude MCP plugin, enabling programmatic/agent-based retrieval of cap table data, which is the core of this story. However, there is no evidence of any 'data room' integration or reconciliation capability — the API/MCP surface is scoped only to cap table and fund data, not financing data-room documents or a reconciliation workflow. Missing for 10: data room access/integration, any documented reconciliation or diffing capability, and independent hands-on evidence of an agent successfully performing this end-to-end workflow.
